reviewDecisions.rationale: Capacity removal is real but inventory and price absorption conflict with the simple bull case; V1.8 must test whether legal capacity, power cost, geography or product mix creates a company exception.
The supply-discipline thesis was real but quarter-end price reversal and downstream resistance make it a strong test of good-news-versus-entry discipline and company differentiation.
NEV demand and lithium pricing are both strong, while capacity expansion is already visible; deep research should test residual expectation room rather than assume commodity strength equals a buy.
Physical demand remains exceptional, but months of strong growth make this a mature-cycle control requiring company cash/working-capital/valuation review.
Higher efficiency thresholds and lower tariff competition point in opposite directions at sector level; V1.8 should explicitly search for technology/cost leaders with a different earnings path.
Global DRAM tightness is real and already price/revenue-confirmed; deep research should fail closed unless a direct current A-share earnings expression exists.
